datasets.verbatim: We refer to the corpus Landslide Segmentation from Satellite Images (originally released as Landslide4Sense 2022) simply as L4S-256 throughout this paper... Barman, 2023. Landslide segmentation (landslide segmentation from satellite images). Version (Accessed: 1 June 2025) https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/niyarrbarman/landslide-divided.

methods.name: Dual-Stream Attention Network
methods.summary: A lightweight encoder-decoder architecture that processes RGB imagery and DEMs through modality-disentangled encoders, merges them via an isometric late-fusion operator, and uses a (≤ 1)-Lipschitz spatial-channel attention gate to modulate skip connections for landslide segmentation.
methods.verbatim: All code, configuration files and trained weights will be released under MIT licence at https://github.com/deepdyn/dualstream-attention, together with a Dockerfile (CUDA 12.1 base image) to guarantee environment replication.

availability.author_statement: "All data sources used in this research have been cited in manuscript."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are referenced and linked via public repositories. The custom code is available through a provided GitHub repository link.
